commentaire: The stage 4 of the Volta a Catalunya was declared null after the riders decided to ride together to the finish in Barcelona, in a mark of respect to Manuel SANROMA VALENCIA (Esp) who died after a crash the stage before. The finishing circuits in Barcelona were skipped, thus shortening the stage from 156 to 109km, and the Fuenlabrada riders did not take the start.
titre: Volta a Catalunya, Stage 3 : Vilanova i la Geltru - Barcelona (109 km)
